datasheet_identity.title: SK82C THRU SK820C SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: SK86C is a Schottky barrier rectifier; the datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time.
The reverse-characteristic plot groups SK82C through SK86C in one solid trace and does not provide a separate SK86C trace.
The typical junction capacitance value is 900 pF for the SK82C-SK86C group at 4 V DC and 1 MHz.
Curve points are direct readings from the published traces; no vendor SPICE model or fitted curve was used.
